articles.summary: Global leaders to gather in Amsterdam to explore climate commitments and real-world action, amongst other crucial topics for institutional investors and asset owners. AMSTERDAM, 10 September 2026 – Morningstar Europe Limited, a subsidiary of Morningstar, Inc. (NASDAQ: MORN) and leading provider of independent investment insights, has announced the agenda for the Morningstar Sustainable Investing Summit to be held on 2-3 February 2027 at Beurs van Berlage, Amsterdam.
